verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a first-party self-hosted deployment, but it is hybrid. Customers run the data-storage infrastructure in their own cloud account and region, while Braintrust still provides the managed UI, authentication and platform updates. So the core product is not fully self-hostable. missing for 10: a fully self-hosted control plane (UI, auth, updates) with no Braintrust-managed dependency, deployment and installation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted install.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You deploy and control the infrastructure that stores your sensitive AI data, while Braintrust provides the managed UI, authentication, and platform updates.
keeping all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts) within your own cloud account and region
Braintrust offers a self-hosted deployment option that separates data storage from platform management.
